## R Markdown


Polymorphism fractions within transcription factor binding sites and their flanking regions in E. coli (Figure 1a) 
```{r}
# Polymorphism threshold and input/output files

tf_factors_ecoli <- read.delim("results/E_coli/tf_1.tsv", row.names = NULL)

# Calculate mean polymorphism in the two flanks and exclude low-confidence sites
tf_factors_ecoli <- tf_factors_ecoli %>%
  mutate(out_site = (right_site + left_site) / 2) %>%
  filter(confidenceLevel != "W")

# Classify points relative to the neutral zone around y = x
tf_factors_ecoli <- tf_factors_ecoli %>%
  mutate(real_d = (out_site - in_site) / sqrt(2),
         zone = case_when(
           real_d >= sd_low & real_d <= sd_up ~ "within neutral zone",
           real_d > sd_up ~ "above y=x",
           real_d < sd_low ~ "below y=x"
         ))

tf_factors_ecoli %>% count(zone)

# Highlight selected transcription factors
tf_factors_ecoli <- tf_factors_ecoli %>%
  mutate(color_group = ifelse(
    regulatorName %in% c("ArcA", "CRP", "Fis", "Fur", "H-NS", "Lrp", "Nac"),
    regulatorName,
    "Other"
  ))

# Calculate the boundaries of the neutral zone
tf_factors_ecoli <- tf_factors_ecoli %>%
  mutate(lower_x = mean_x - sd_low / sqrt(2),
         lower_y = mean_y + sd_low / sqrt(2),
         upper_x = mean_x - sd_up / sqrt(2),
         upper_y = mean_y + sd_up / sqrt(2))

tf_factors_ecoli_sorted <- tf_factors_ecoli %>% arrange(mean_x)

polygon_data <- bind_rows(
  tf_factors_ecoli_sorted %>% transmute(x = lower_x, y = lower_y),
  tf_factors_ecoli_sorted %>% arrange(desc(mean_x)) %>% transmute(x = upper_x, y = upper_y)
)

# Plot polymorphism inside and outside TF binding sites
tf_factors_plot_ecoli <- ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = polygon_data, aes(x = x, y = y), fill = "gray30", alpha = 0.15, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_jitter(data = tf_factors_ecoli, aes(x = in_site, y = out_site, color = color_group),
              width = 0.0005, height = 0.0005, alpha = 0.8, size = 1.5) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "#006065", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(x = "Fraction of polymorphic positions in the TF site",
       y = "Fraction of polymorphic positions in flanking regions",
       title = expression(italic(E.~coli))) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "TF",
                     values = c("ArcA" = "#3498db", "CRP" = "#38b000", "Fis" = "darkblue",
                                "Fur" = "red", "H-NS" = "#393a41", "Lrp" = "#ac11ff",
                                "Nac" = "#f15bb5", "Other" = "orange"),
                     breaks = c("ArcA", "CRP", "Fis", "Fur", "H-NS", "Lrp", "Nac", "Other")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.position = "right",
  plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5),
  aspect.ratio = 1
  ) 

tf_factors_plot_ecoli
```

Test the proportion of E. coli TFBSs above the neutral zone (Table 1)
```{r}
res <- binom.test(
  x = 471,
  n = 471 + 167,
  p = 0.5,
  alternative = "two.sided"
)

cat("Proportion:", round(471 / 638 * 100, 1), "%\n")
cat("P-value:", res$p.value, "\n")
```

 Mean polymorphism fractions within and outside binding sites of the same transcription factors in E. coli (Figure 1c)

```{r}
# Read factor-level polymorphism data
tf_factors_ecoli <- read.delim("results/E_coli/tf_mean.tsv", row.names = NULL)

# Classify factors relative to the neutral zone around y = x
tf_factors_ecoli <- tf_factors_ecoli %>%
  mutate(real_d = (mean_out_site - mean_in_site) / sqrt(2),
         zone = case_when(
           real_d >= sd_low & real_d <= sd_up ~ "within neutral zone",
           real_d > sd_up ~ "above y=x",
           real_d < sd_low ~ "below y=x"
         ))

tf_factors_ecoli %>% count(zone)

# Highlight selected transcription factors
tf_factors_ecoli <- tf_factors_ecoli %>%
  mutate(color_group = ifelse(
    name %in% c("ArcA", "CRP", "Fis", "Fur", "H-NS", "Lrp", "Nac"),
    name,
    "Other"
  ))

# Calculate the boundaries of the neutral zone
tf_factors_ecoli <- tf_factors_ecoli %>%
  mutate(lower_x = mean_x - sd_low / sqrt(2),
         lower_y = mean_y + sd_low / sqrt(2),
         upper_x = mean_x - sd_up / sqrt(2),
         upper_y = mean_y + sd_up / sqrt(2))

tf_factors_ecoli_sorted <- tf_factors_ecoli %>% arrange(mean_x)

polygon_data <- bind_rows(
  tf_factors_ecoli_sorted %>% transmute(x = lower_x, y = lower_y),
  tf_factors_ecoli_sorted %>% arrange(desc(mean_x)) %>% transmute(x = upper_x, y = upper_y)
)

# Plot mean polymorphism inside and outside TF binding sites
tf_factors_plot_ecoli_mean <- ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = polygon_data, aes(x = x, y = y), fill = "gray30", alpha = 0.15, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_jitter(data = tf_factors_ecoli, aes(x = mean_in_site, y = mean_out_site, color = color_group),
              width = 0.0005, height = 0.0005, alpha = 0.8, size = 1.5) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "#006065", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(x = "Mean fraction of polymorphic positions in TF sites",
       y = "Mean fraction of polymorphic positions in flanking regions") +
  scale_color_manual(name = "TF",
                     values = c("ArcA" = "#3498db", "CRP" = "#38b000", "Fis" = "darkblue",
                                "Fur" = "red", "H-NS" = "#393a41", "Lrp" = "#ac11ff",
                                "Nac" = "#f15bb5", "Other" = "orange"),
                     breaks = c("ArcA", "CRP", "Fis", "Fur", "H-NS", "Lrp", "Nac", "Other")) +
  theme_minimal() +
    theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.position = "right",
  plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5),
  aspect.ratio = 1
)
```

Histograms of the log2 ratio between the mean polymorphism fraction within the binding sites and that in their flanking regions for each E. coli transcription factor (Figure 1e)
```{r}
# Calculate the within-site to outside-site polymorphism ratio
tf_factors_conserv_ecoli <- tf_factors_ecoli %>% mutate(out_site = mean_out_site + 0.001, in_site = mean_in_site + 0.001) %>% mutate(conserv = in_site / out_site)
tf_factors_conserv_ecoli <- tf_factors_conserv_ecoli[order(tf_factors_conserv_ecoli$conserv),]

tf_factors_conserv_ecoli$name <- factor(tf_factors_conserv_ecoli$name, levels = tf_factors_conserv_ecoli$name)


# Plot log2 within-site to outside-site polymorphism ratios
tf_factors_hist_ecoli <- ggplot(tf_factors_conserv_ecoli %>% mutate(log_conserv = ifelse(conserv >= 0.94 & conserv <= 1.02, -0.01, log2(conserv))), aes(x = name, y = log_conserv)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#FFBA00", width = 0.4) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = expression(italic(E.~coli)), y = "log2(in/out)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 6.5),
        axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(8, 6, 4, 2, 0, -2, -4, -6, -8), minor_breaks = NULL, limits = c(-9, 8))

tf_factors_hist_ecoli
```

Calculate median conservation across all E. coli TFs and for TFs outside the neutral zone
```{r}
cat("Median log2 conservation across all TFs:", median(log2(tf_factors_conserv_ecoli$conserv), na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Median log2 conservation for TFs outside the neutral zone:", tf_factors_conserv_ecoli%>% filter(zone != "within neutral zone") %>%
    summarise(median_conserv = median(log2(conserv), na.rm = TRUE)) %>% pull(median_conserv),"\n")
```

Collect figures in panel
```{r}

tf_panel <-
  (tf_factors_plot_ecoli + tf_factors_bac_all_plot) /
  (tf_factors_plot_ecoli_mean + tf_factors_bac_plot) /
  tf_factors_hist_ecoli /
  tf_gist_bac +
  plot_layout(
    heights = c(1, 1, 0.7, 0.5)
  ) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"), plot.margin = margin(5, 8, 5, 8))

ggsave(
  "figures/tf_factors.jpeg",
  plot = tf_panel,
  width = 16,
  height = 20,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)
```


Polymorphism fractions within E. coli proximal promoter elements and their flanking regions (Figure 2a)
```{r}
# Read proximal promoter data and calculate mean polymorphism in flanking regions
promoter_prox_ecoli <- read.delim("results/E_coli/prox.tsv", row.names = NULL)
promoter_prox_ecoli <- promoter_prox_ecoli %>% mutate(out_site = (right_site + left_site) / 2)

# Classify points relative to the neutral zone around y = x
promoter_prox_ecoli <- promoter_prox_ecoli %>%
  mutate(real_d = (out_site - in_site) / sqrt(2),
         zone = case_when(
           real_d >= sd_low & real_d <= sd_up ~ "within neutral zone",
           real_d > sd_up ~ "above y=x",
           real_d < sd_low ~ "below y=x"
         ))

promoter_prox_ecoli %>% count(zone)

# Calculate the boundaries of the neutral zone
promoter_prox_ecoli <- promoter_prox_ecoli %>%
  mutate(lower_x = mean_x - sd_low / sqrt(2), lower_y = mean_y + sd_low / sqrt(2),
         upper_x = mean_x - sd_up / sqrt(2), upper_y = mean_y + sd_up / sqrt(2))

promoter_prox_ecoli_sorted <- promoter_prox_ecoli %>% arrange(mean_x)

polygon_data <- bind_rows(
  promoter_prox_ecoli_sorted %>% transmute(x = lower_x, y = lower_y),
  promoter_prox_ecoli_sorted %>% arrange(desc(mean_x)) %>% transmute(x = upper_x, y = upper_y)
)

# Group promoters by sigma factor
promoter_prox_ecoli <- promoter_prox_ecoli %>%
  mutate(sigma_group = case_when(
    sigmaFactor == "sigma70" ~ "sigma70",
    sigmaFactor == "sigma28" ~ "sigma28",
    sigmaFactor == "sigma32" ~ "sigma32",
    sigmaFactor == "sigma38" ~ "sigma38",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ))

# Plot polymorphism in proximal promoter elements and their flanks
prom_prox_ecoli <- ggplot(promoter_prox_ecoli %>% filter(sigma_group != "Other"), aes(in_site, out_site, color = sigma_group)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.005, height = 0.005, alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  geom_polygon(data = polygon_data, aes(x = x, y = y), fill = "gray30", alpha = 0.15, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Fraction of polymorphic positions in the proximal element",
       y = "Fraction of polymorphic positions in flanking regions",
       color = "Sigma factor", title = expression(italic(E.~coli))) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 8)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "#006065") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("sigma70" = "#9b2226", "sigma32" = "#8ecae6", "sigma28" = "orange", "sigma38" = "#984EA3"),
                     labels = c("sigma70" = expression(sigma^70), "sigma32" = expression(sigma^32),
                                "sigma28" = expression(sigma^28), "sigma38" = expression(sigma^38))) +
    theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.position = "right",
  aspect.ratio = 1
)

prom_prox_ecoli

```

Histogram of the log2 ratio between the polymorphism fraction in E. coli proximal promoter elements and that in their flanking regions for all promoters (Supplementary figure 2a)
```{r}
# Calculate the ratio of polymorphism inside and outside proximal elements
promoter_prox_conserv_ecoli_all <- promoter_prox_ecoli  %>% mutate(out_site = out_site + 0.001, in_site = in_site + 0.001) %>% mutate(conserv = in_site/out_site)

# Plot log2 histogram
promoter_prox_hist_ecoli_all <- ggplot(promoter_prox_conserv_ecoli_all%>% 
                      mutate(log_conserv = ifelse(conserv == 1, -0.06, log2(conserv))), aes(x = pmName, y = log_conserv)) +
  geom_bar(stat = 'identity', width = 0.4,  fill = "#8C4251") +
  theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "none")+
  labs(y = "log2(in/out)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1, size = 7.5)) +

  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 13)) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 18)) + theme(
  axis.title.x = element_blank(),
  axis.text.x = element_blank(),
  axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
)

promoter_prox_hist_ecoli_all

```

Histogram of the log2 ratio between the polymorphism fraction in E. coli proximal promoter elements and that in their flanking regions for promoters with non-zero polymorphism in both regions (Supplementary figure 2b)

```{r}
# Calculate the ratio of polymorphism inside and outside proximal elements
promoter_prox_conserv_ecoli <- promoter_prox_ecoli %>% filter(in_site >  0 & out_site > 0) %>% mutate(out_site = out_site + 0.001, in_site = in_site + 0.001) %>% mutate(conserv = in_site/out_site)

promoter_prox_conserv_ecoli$pmName <- factor(promoter_prox_conserv_ecoli$pmName, levels = promoter_prox_conserv_ecoli$pmName)
# Plot log2 histogram
promoter_prox_hist_ecoli <- ggplot(promoter_prox_conserv_ecoli%>% 
                      mutate(log_conserv = ifelse(conserv == 1, -0.02, log2(conserv))), aes(x = pmName, y = log_conserv)) +
```

Polymorphism fractions within E. coli distal elements and their flanking regions (Figure 2b)
```{r}
# Read distal promoter data and calculate mean polymorphism in flanking regions
promoter_dist_ecoli <- read.delim("results/E_coli/dist.tsv", row.names = NULL)
promoter_dist_ecoli <- promoter_dist_ecoli %>% mutate(out_site = (right_site + left_site) / 2)

promoter_dist_ecoli_id <- promoter_dist_ecoli %>%
  group_by(pmId) %>%
  summarise(mean_in_site = first(in_site), mean_out_site = first(out_site))

# Classify points relative to the neutral zone around y = x
promoter_dist_ecoli <- promoter_dist_ecoli %>%
  mutate(real_d = (out_site - in_site) / sqrt(2),
         zone = case_when(
           real_d >= sd_low & real_d <= sd_up ~ "within neutral zone",
           real_d > sd_up ~ "above y=x",
           real_d < sd_low ~ "below y=x"
         ))

promoter_dist_ecoli %>% count(zone)

# Calculate the boundaries of the neutral zone
promoter_dist_ecoli <- promoter_dist_ecoli %>%
  mutate(lower_x = mean_x - sd_low / sqrt(2), lower_y = mean_y + sd_low / sqrt(2),
         upper_x = mean_x - sd_up / sqrt(2), upper_y = mean_y + sd_up / sqrt(2))

promoter_dist_ecoli_sorted <- promoter_dist_ecoli %>% arrange(mean_x)

polygon_data <- bind_rows(
  promoter_dist_ecoli_sorted %>% transmute(x = lower_x, y = lower_y),
  promoter_dist_ecoli_sorted %>% arrange(desc(mean_x)) %>% transmute(x = upper_x, y = upper_y)
)

# Group promoters by sigma factor
promoter_dist_ecoli <- promoter_dist_ecoli %>%
  mutate(sigma_group = case_when(
    sigmaFactor == "sigma70" ~ "sigma70",
    sigmaFactor == "sigma28" ~ "sigma28",
    sigmaFactor == "sigma32" ~ "sigma32",
    sigmaFactor == "sigma38" ~ "sigma38",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ))

# Plot polymorphism in distal promoter elements and their flanks
prom_dist_ecoli <- ggplot(promoter_dist_ecoli %>% filter(sigma_group != "Other"), aes(in_site, out_site, color = sigma_group)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.005, height = 0.005, alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  geom_polygon(data = polygon_data, aes(x = x, y = y), fill = "gray30", alpha = 0.15, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Fraction of polymorphic positions in the distal element",
       y = "Fraction of polymorphic positions in flanking regions",
       color = "Sigma factor", title = expression(italic(E.~coli))) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 8)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "#006065") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("sigma70" = "#645394", "sigma32" = "#8ecae6", "sigma28" = "orange", "sigma38" = "#9b2226"),
                     labels = c("sigma70" = expression(sigma^70), "sigma32" = expression(sigma^32),
                                "sigma28" = expression(sigma^28), "sigma38" = expression(sigma^38))) +
    theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.position = "right",
  aspect.ratio = 1
)
prom_dist_ecoli
```

Compare polymorphism presence between proximal and distal E. coli promoter elements (Table 2)
```{r}
scatter_data <- promoter_dist_ecoli %>%
  select(pmName, dist_in_site = in_site, dist_out_site = out_site) %>%
  left_join(promoter_prox_ecoli %>% select(pmName, prox_in_site = in_site, prox_out_site = out_site), by = "pmName")

# Build a contingency table for polymorphism presence in distal and proximal sites
table_prox_dist <- with(scatter_data, matrix(c(
  sum(dist_in_site == 0 & prox_in_site == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
  sum(dist_in_site == 0 & prox_in_site > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
  sum(dist_in_site > 0 & prox_in_site == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
  sum(dist_in_site > 0 & prox_in_site > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE, dimnames = list(`Distal site` = c("0", ">0"), `Proximal site` = c("0", ">0"))))

table_prox_dist

# McNemar's test
mcnemar.test(table_prox_dist)

# Chi-squared test
chisq.test(table_prox_dist)

# Calculate the odds ratio
OR <- (table_prox_dist[1, 1] * table_prox_dist[2, 2]) / (table_prox_dist[1, 2] * table_prox_dist[2, 1])
cat("Odds ratio:", OR, "\n")
```

```{r}
# Calculate the ratio of polymorphism inside and outside distal elements
promoter_dist_conserv_bac <- promoter_dist_bac %>% filter(in_site > 0 & out_site > 0) %>% mutate(out_site = out_site + 0.001, in_site = in_site + 0.001, conserv = in_site / out_site) %>%
  arrange(conserv) %>% distinct(pmName, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% mutate(log_conserv = ifelse(conserv == 1, -0.04, log2(conserv)), pm_id = factor(seq_len(n()), levels = seq_len(n())))

# Plot log2 histogram
promoter_dist_hist_bac <- ggplot(promoter_dist_conserv_bac, aes(x = pm_id, y = log_conserv)) +
  geom_bar(stat = 'identity', width = 0.4, fill = "#645394") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = promoter_dist_conserv_bac$pmName) +
  theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(x = expression(italic(B.~subtilis)),  y = "log2(in/out)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 12)) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 13)) +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 16)) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 18))+ theme(
  axis.title.x = element_blank()
)

promoter_dist_hist_bac
```

Compare polymorphism presence between proximal and distal B. subtilis promoter elements (Table 2)
```{r}
# Combine proximal and distal promoter data by promoter ID
scatter_data <- promoter_dist_bac %>%
  select(pmId, dist_in_site = in_site, dist_out_site = out_site) %>%
  left_join(
    promoter_prox_bac %>% select(pmId, prox_in_site = in_site, prox_out_site = out_site),
    by = "pmId"
  )

# Construct a 2x2 table of polymorphism presence in proximal and distal elements
table_prox_dist <- with(
  scatter_data,
  matrix(
    c(
      sum(dist_in_site == 0 & prox_in_site == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum(dist_in_site == 0 & prox_in_site > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum(dist_in_site > 0 & prox_in_site == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum(dist_in_site > 0 & prox_in_site > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    nrow = 2,
    byrow = TRUE,
    dimnames = list(
      `Distal site` = c("0", ">0"),
      `Proximal site` = c("0", ">0")
    )
  )
)

table_prox_dist

# McNemar's test
mcnemar.test(table_prox_dist)

# Chi-squared test
chisq.test(table_prox_dist)

# Calculate the odds ratio
OR <- (table_prox_dist[1, 1] * table_prox_dist[2, 2]) /
  (table_prox_dist[1, 2] * table_prox_dist[2, 1])

cat("Odds ratio:", OR, "\n")
```

Polymorphism fractions within E. coli non-coding RNAs and their flanking regions (Figure 3a)
```{r}
# Read RNA polymorphism data and calculate the mean polymorphism in flanking regions
dif_rna_ecoli <- read.delim("results/E_coli/rna.tsv", header = TRUE, sep = "\t", row.names = NULL, check.names = FALSE)
dif_rna_ecoli <- dif_rna_ecoli %>% mutate(out_site = (right_site + left_site) / 2) 

# Add analyses using only the left or right flank
dif_rna_ecoli_right <- read.delim("results/E_coli/rna_right.tsv", header = TRUE, sep = "\t", row.names = NULL, check.names = FALSE)
dif_rna_ecoli_left <- read.delim("results/E_coli/rna_left.tsv", header = TRUE, sep = "\t", row.names = NULL, check.names = FALSE)

dif_rna_ecoli <- bind_rows(dif_rna_ecoli_right, dif_rna_ecoli_left, dif_rna_ecoli %>% select(-left_site, -right_site))

# Classify points relative to the neutral zone around y = x
dif_rna_ecoli <- dif_rna_ecoli %>%
  mutate(real_d = (out_site - in_site) / sqrt(2),
         zone = case_when(
           real_d >= sd_low & real_d <= sd_up ~ "within neutral zone",
           real_d > sd_up ~ "above y=x",
           real_d < sd_low ~ "below y=x"
         ))

dif_rna_ecoli %>% count(zone)

# Calculate the coordinates of the neutral-zone boundaries
dif_rna_ecoli <- dif_rna_ecoli %>%
  mutate(lower_x = mean_x - sd_low / sqrt(2),
         lower_y = mean_y + sd_low / sqrt(2),
         upper_x = mean_x - sd_up / sqrt(2),
         upper_y = mean_y + sd_up / sqrt(2))

dif_rna_ecoli_sorted <- dif_rna_ecoli %>% arrange(mean_x)


polygon_data <- bind_rows(
  dif_rna_ecoli_sorted %>% transmute(x = lower_x, y = lower_y),
  dif_rna_ecoli_sorted %>% arrange(desc(mean_x)) %>% transmute(x = upper_x, y = upper_y)
)

max_val <- max(dif_rna_ecoli$in_site, dif_rna_ecoli$out_site, polygon_data$x, polygon_data$y, na.rm = TRUE)
dif_rna_ecoli <- dif_rna_ecoli %>%
  mutate(point_shape = ifelse(grepl("gene", class, ignore.case = TRUE),
                              "small RNA gene", "regulatory RNA element"))
# Plot polymorphism inside and outside non-coding RNAs
rna_plot_ecoli <- ggplot(dif_rna_ecoli, aes(x = in_site, y = out_site,
                                            shape = point_shape)) +
  geom_polygon(data = polygon_data, aes(x = x, y = y),
               fill = "gray30", alpha = 0.15, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_point(color = '#70ae6e', size = 2) +
  labs(x = "Fraction of polymorphic positions in the non-coding RNA",
       y = "Fraction of polymorphic positions in flanking regions",
       title = expression(italic(E.~coli))) +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "#006065") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, max_val)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max_val)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("small RNA gene" = 17,
                                "regulatory RNA element" = 16),
                     name = "Class") +
  guides(shape = guide_legend(
    override.aes = list(color = "gray50", size = 3)
  )) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.position = "right",
    aspect.ratio = 1
  )

rna_plot_ecoli

```

Test the proportion of E. coli RNAs above the neutral zone
```{r}
res <- binom.test(
  x = 14,
  n = 18,
  p = 0.5,
  alternative = "two.sided"
)

cat("Proportion:", round(14 / 18 * 100, 1), "%\n")
cat("P-value:", res$p.value, "\n")
```

```{r}
# Read RNA structure polymorphism data
dif_rna_one <- read.delim("results/B_subtilis/rnas_structure.tsv", header = TRUE, sep = "\t", row.names = NULL, check.names = FALSE)
dif_rna_one <- dif_rna_one %>% filter(size > 100)

# Statistical analysis
test <- suppressWarnings(
  wilcox.test(dif_rna_one$paired, dif_rna_one$unpaired, paired = TRUE, alternative = "two.sided")
)
test

median_difference <- median(dif_rna_one$paired - dif_rna_one$unpaired, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("Median difference (paired - unpaired):", median_difference, "\n")

```

Plot polymorphism in paired and unpaired B. subtilis RNA positions (Figure 5a)
```{r}
# Reshape the data for the boxplot
df_long_rna <- dif_rna_one %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(paired, unpaired), names_to = "structure", values_to = "polymorphism_rate")

# Plot polymorphism in paired and unpaired RNA positions
dif_rna_boxplot <-  ggplot(df_long_rna, aes(x = structure, y = polymorphism_rate, fill = structure)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(aes(color = structure), width = 0.2, size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("paired" = "Paired positions", "unpaired" = "Unpaired positions")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("paired" = "#6C9EC9", "unpaired" = "#52BBAD")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("paired" = "#6C9EC9", "unpaired" = "#52BBAD")) +
    labs(x = "", y = "Fraction of polymorphic positions in RNA") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10)) +
    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = list(c("paired", "unpaired")),
      paired = TRUE,
      method = "wilcox.test",
      method.args = list(exact = FALSE),
      label = "p.format"
    )

dif_rna_boxplot
```


Compare polymorphism between B. subtilis terminator structures
```{r}
term_bac <- read.delim("results/B_subtilis/term_structure.tsv", row.names = NULL) %>%
  mutate(paired_hairpin = paired_hairpin / 2)

# Compare polymorphism rates between terminator structures
friedman.test(as.matrix(term_bac[, c("in_tail", "paired_hairpin", "loop")]))

pvals <- c(
  "tail vs paired hairpin" = wilcox.test(term_bac$in_tail, term_bac$paired_hairpin, paired = TRUE)$p.value,
  "tail vs loop" = wilcox.test(term_bac$in_tail, term_bac$loop, paired = TRUE)$p.value,
  "paired hairpin vs loop" = wilcox.test(term_bac$paired_hairpin, term_bac$loop, paired = TRUE)$p.value
)

p_adj <- p.adjust(pvals, method = "holm")
cat("Holm-adjusted pairwise Wilcoxon p-values:\n")
print(p_adj)
```

Plot polymorphism rates across B. subtilis terminator structures (Figure 5b)

```{r}
term_long <- term_bac %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(in_tail, paired_hairpin, loop), names_to = "structure", values_to = "polymorphism_rate")

term_long_nonzero <- term_long %>% filter(polymorphism_rate > 0)
term_long_zero <- term_long %>% filter(polymorphism_rate == 0)

# Prepare adjusted p-values for pairwise comparisons
stat.test <- data.frame(
  group1 = c("in_tail", "in_tail", "paired_hairpin"),
  group2 = c("paired_hairpin", "loop", "loop"),
  p.adj = p_adj,
  y.position = c(1.3, 1.2, 1.2)
) %>%
  mutate(label = formatC(p.adj, format = "e", digits = 2))

# Plot polymorphism rates across terminator structures
term_box <- ggplot() +
  geom_boxplot(data = term_long, aes(x = structure, y = polymorphism_rate, fill = structure),
               alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_jitter(data = term_long_nonzero, aes(x = structure, y = polymorphism_rate, color = structure),
              size = 2, alpha = 0.6, width = 0.2, height = 0, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_jitter(data = term_long_zero, aes(x = structure, y = polymorphism_rate, color = structure),
              size = 2, alpha = 0.6, width = 0.2, height = 0.005, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("in_tail" = "Poly-U tail", "loop" = "Loop", "paired_hairpin" = "Stem")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("in_tail" = "#d5573b", "paired_hairpin" = "#70ae6e", "loop" = "#777da7")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("in_tail" = "#d5573b", "paired_hairpin" = "#70ae6e", "loop" = "#777da7")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10)) +
  labs(x = " ", y = "Fraction of polymorphic positions in terminator") +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test, label = "label", xmin = "group1", xmax = "group2",
                     y.position = "y.position", tip.length = 0.01)

term_box

```

Change polymorphism threshold
```{r}
make_tf_plot <- function(polymorphism_threshold) {

  input_file <- paste0("results/E_coli/tf_", polymorphism_threshold, ".tsv")

  tf_factors_ecoli <- read.delim(input_file, row.names = NULL) %>%
    mutate(out_site = (right_site + left_site) / 2) %>%
    filter(confidenceLevel != "W") %>%
    mutate(
      real_d = (out_site - in_site) / sqrt(2),
      zone = case_when(
        real_d >= sd_low & real_d <= sd_up ~ "within neutral zone",
        real_d > sd_up ~ "above y=x",
        real_d < sd_low ~ "below y=x"
      ),
      color_group = ifelse(
        regulatorName %in% c("ArcA", "CRP", "Fis", "Fur", "H-NS", "Lrp", "Nac"),
        regulatorName,
        "Other"
      ),
      lower_x = mean_x - sd_low / sqrt(2),
      lower_y = mean_y + sd_low / sqrt(2),
      upper_x = mean_x - sd_up / sqrt(2),
      upper_y = mean_y + sd_up / sqrt(2)
    )
      # Binomial test: points above vs below the neutral zone
    zone_counts <- tf_factors_ecoli %>%
      filter(zone != "within neutral zone") %>%
      count(zone)
  
    n_above <- sum(zone_counts$n[zone_counts$zone == "above y=x"])
    n_below <- sum(zone_counts$n[zone_counts$zone == "below y=x"])
    n_outside <- n_above + n_below
  
    if (n_outside > 0) {
      res <- binom.test(
        x = n_above,
        n = n_outside,
        p = 0.5,
        alternative = "two.sided"
      )

    cat("\nThreshold:", polymorphism_threshold, "\n")
    cat("Points above:", n_above, "\n")
    cat("Points below:", n_below, "\n")
    cat("Proportion above:", round(n_above / n_outside * 100, 1), "%\n")
    cat("P-value:", res$p.value, "\n")
  }
  tf_factors_ecoli_sorted <- tf_factors_ecoli %>%
    arrange(mean_x)

  polygon_data <- bind_rows(
    tf_factors_ecoli_sorted %>%
      transmute(x = lower_x, y = lower_y),
    tf_factors_ecoli_sorted %>%
      arrange(desc(mean_x)) %>%
      transmute(x = upper_x, y = upper_y)
  )

  tf_factors_plot_ecoli <- ggplot() +
    geom_polygon(
      data = polygon_data,
      aes(x = x, y = y),
      fill = "gray30",
      alpha = 0.15,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      data = tf_factors_ecoli,
      aes(x = in_site, y = out_site, color = color_group),
      width = 0.0005,
      height = 0.0005,
      alpha = 0.8,
      size = 1.5
    ) +
    geom_abline(
      intercept = 0,
      slope = 1,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "#006065",
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Fraction of polymorphic positions in the TF site",
      y = "Fraction of polymorphic positions in flanking regions",
      title = bquote(.(polymorphism_threshold))
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      name = "TF",
      values = c(
        "ArcA" = "#3498db",
        "CRP" = "#38b000",
        "Fis" = "darkblue",
        "Fur" = "red",
        "H-NS" = "#393a41",
        "Lrp" = "#ac11ff",
        "Nac" = "#f15bb5",
        "Other" = "orange"
      ),
      breaks = c(
        "ArcA", "CRP", "Fis", "Fur",
        "H-NS", "Lrp", "Nac", "Other"
      )
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5),
      aspect.ratio = 1
    )

  return(tf_factors_plot_ecoli)
}

tf_plot_1 <- make_tf_plot(1)
tf_plot_2 <- make_tf_plot(5)
tf_plot_3 <- make_tf_plot(10)
tf_plot_4 <- make_tf_plot(100)

```


Make panel with different threshold (Supplementary figure 1)
```{r}
tf_threshold <-
  (tf_plot_1 + tf_plot_2) /
  (tf_plot_3 + tf_plot_4) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"))

ggsave(
  "figures/tf_treshold.jpeg",
  plot = tf_threshold,
  width = 14,
  height = 12,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)
```
